assumptions: Supplied customer evidence is bounded text with stable source IDs; it is not proof of market-wide prevalence.
cost_drivers: Number and length of supplied sources, extracted objections, and grouped recommendations.
effects: Uses up to two managed model calls and writes one JSON customer-objections artifact in the bound project; no connected-provider requests or other external effects.

cases.description: Repeated comparison concerns from distinct customer evidence types are grouped and mapped.

source_texts: I need a comparison before I can justify the purchase.
Our team needs a clear comparison with the incumbent before approval.

cases.description: Evidence without a supported purchase objection reports its limitation rather than inventing one.
Reject a plausible input that cannot provide unambiguous evidence citations.

rubric.question: Does every objection and recommendation cite only supplied source IDs and exact evidence excerpts?
Does every recommendation use only the fixed marketing-surface taxonomy?
